title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: customers in regulated environments require enforced KMS key residency and full audit trails for key usage. This PR hardens RBAC v2 to (1) enforce KMS region pinning at policy-evaluation time, (2) emit structured audit logs for all KMS-related decisions and key usages, and (3) add server-side validations and migration to record KMS residency metadata. The changes are additive but include a short feature-flag-backed rollout path to avoid immediate global enforcement. Checklist: - [x] Add RBAC v2 constraint type `kms_region_policy` - [x] Implement policy evaluation hook and upstream enforcement in api-server - [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS actions (encrypt/decrypt/unwrap) - [x] DB migration to store kms_residency metadata and audit index - [x] Integration tests + e2e harness updates - [x] Docs and release notes. Rollout plan: behind feature flag "rbac_kms_region_enforce" defaulting to off for 48 hours post-merge; gradually enable per-account via console toggle and automated canary tests. Related: aligns with ENG-4521 and previous rbac-v2 audit work (see pr-314159 and pr-292345).
